text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah. A message... it's from Kris S. 
"Waiting in the gym. Blood flow 
restriction training scheduled for today"—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay...! It's suffocating, tight, and 
feels like it's totally crushing me 
down...! I hate it...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it's gonna be—all right! 
Today's training is canceled! Let's go get 
some galettes!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
See, the "Voice of Destiny" says so too— 
today is the ultimate galette day, where 
you'll encounter a sweet, crispy galette!
